info.title: conta-verde public API
info.description: The public `v1` API. It is frozen: it only grows (new endpoints, new optional request fields, new response fields and new enum values). Clients must ignore response fields they do not know and treat an enum value they do not know as "other". A breaking change is a `v2`, and `v1` is kept for a year after it. Decimals are strings, dates are `YYYY-MM-DD`. Errors are RFC 9457 problem documents. Every answer carries `RateLimit-Limit`, `RateLimit-Remaining` and `RateLimit-Reset`; a request refused for rate is a `429` with `Retry-After`.

bearer.description: An API key made by an owner or admin of the company: `Authorization: Bearer cvk_...`. A key belongs to one company and has scopes (`area:read`, `area:write`).

code.description: Stable. A client that sees a code it does not know treats it as `internal` of that status.
